title: useContractData loads ALL contracts client-side then paginates in memory
detail: Line 31: `fetchContractsPaginated('')` â€” the 'Paginated' name is misleading; it fetches all contracts in one query (Power Pages does not support $skip so server-side pagination is not an option). Client-side slice at line 72. Works today at ~200 contracts. Scales poorly to 2,000+.
recommendedFix: Accept the current pattern â€” Power Pages limitation is real. Add `$top=5000` cap to fetchContractsPaginated as a safety. Document the scale ceiling in a comment. Mitigation path: switch to a server-side rollup table when load exceeds 1000 contracts.
